about: The big chunks of SSE4 the performance readout and the minimum spec table group timings by (PF1, design/SSE4-performance-and-minimum-spec.md). Each source is a kernel op, a job (job:<kind>), or a page measurement (render.*, page.*); start-up stages are stamps kept apart in the report. budget_ms is what a call's 95th percentile must stay within on a device for that device to meet the chunk's minimum spec. Anything not listed falls in 'other', named by its op, so nothing hides. bench lists the engine scenarios (crates/sse-wasm, engine_run) the bench on /harness/ times for the chunk: the same work on every device, for comparing machines and for ND3b's before-and-after check (PF2).

chunks.name: Opening the app
chunks.meaning: Starting the kernel, loading the packs, opening the universe and measuring the device, once per visit.

chunks.name: Working out a system
chunks.meaning: Resolving a system and its worlds from the packs and the chronicle: what every card, chart, edit and search reads. A click must not wait on it.

chunks.name: Making and ageing a system
chunks.meaning: Importing a V3 save, the formation run and the look-ahead through deep time. Long, so it shows progress; the budget is for the whole run.

chunks.name: Climate and weather
chunks.meaning: A world's climate bands and today's weather.

chunks.name: Surfaces, caves and descents
chunks.meaning: Surface tiles and their history (plates, wear, impacts), cave surveys and descents. A survey is a deliberate act, so the budget is longer.

chunks.name: Light, spectra and the sky
chunks.meaning: Starlight, spectra, activity, air optics, nebulae, planet finding, the sky from a world and light bent by gravity.

chunks.name: Matter, fields and names
chunks.meaning: Look-ups on the master data sheet, phases, magnetic fields, element inventories, and names.

chunks.name: Life
chunks.meaning: A world's biosphere, its history and its signatures.

chunks.name: Galaxy and cosmic web
chunks.meaning: The galaxy chart, star and halo cells, the cosmic web, the Window and sector import and export.

chunks.name: Orbits, routes and voyages
chunks.meaning: Where everything is at a time, the calendar, routes between stars and voyages in a system.

chunks.name: Seats, rules and programs
chunks.meaning: The game layer: seats and grants, disclosure, rules, ship programs, intents and the chronicle's notes.

chunks.name: Drawing
chunks.meaning: One frame: the globe's own drawing time, each pass's share of it, and the page's frame interval. 33 ms is 30 frames a second.

chunks.name: Clicks and keys
chunks.meaning: From a click or key to the next paint (the browser's event timing). 200 ms is the web's own line for 'good'.
